d:
The search for Bigfoot is far from over! The team heads deeper into the wilderness, following eyewitness accounts, examining mysterious evidence and investigating reports of strange activity. With every new lead comes another possibility, but will these investigations bring them any closer to finding the elusive creature?
Watch Finding Bigfoot, S2, Episodes 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14 & 15 on Discovery Channel India.
